run_doctest_nested: run the doctest suite that verifies nested class exposure from the nested_ext C extension module
run_conditional_checker: run the ConditionalChecker to validate doctest output across Python 2 and Python 3 version differences
test_nested_class_attributes: test that nested class X and nested class X.Y have correct module and name attributes
test_nested_enum_repr: test that nested enum X.color and X.color.red produce correct repr strings on Python 2 and 3
test_function_signature: test that test_function exposes correct signature documentation for nested class arguments X and X.Y
